name: mortgage-bdd-playwright
description: BDD Playwright test framework for Mortgage Advice Bureau

scripts.test: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/utils/world.ts --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/searchSteps.ts --require src/steps/sortFilterSteps.ts --require src/steps/apiValidationSteps.ts tests/features
scripts.test:headed: set HEADED=true&& npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/utils/world.ts --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/searchSteps.ts --require src/steps/sortFilterSteps.ts --require src/steps/apiValidationSteps.ts tests/features
scripts.test:search: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/utils/world.ts --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/searchSteps.ts --require src/steps/sortFilterSteps.ts --require src/steps/apiValidationSteps.ts --tags @search tests/features
scripts.test:sort: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/utils/world.ts --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/searchSteps.ts --require src/steps/sortFilterSteps.ts --require src/steps/apiValidationSteps.ts --tags @sorting tests/features
scripts.test:filter: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/utils/world.ts --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/searchSteps.ts --require src/steps/sortFilterSteps.ts --require src/steps/apiValidationSteps.ts --tags @filtering tests/features
scripts.test:api: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/utils/world.ts --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/searchSteps.ts --require src/steps/sortFilterSteps.ts --require src/steps/apiValidationSteps.ts --tags @api tests/features
scripts.test:smoke: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/utils/world.ts --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/searchSteps.ts --require src/steps/sortFilterSteps.ts --require src/steps/apiValidationSteps.ts --tags @smoke tests/features
scripts.test:dryrun: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/utils/world.ts --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/searchSteps.ts --require src/steps/sortFilterSteps.ts --require src/steps/apiValidationSteps.ts --dry-run tests/features
scripts.test:report: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/utils/world.ts --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/searchSteps.ts --require src/steps/sortFilterSteps.ts --require src/steps/apiValidationSteps.ts --format progress-bar --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json tests/features && node src/utils/generateReport.js
